shortDescription: Fervo Energy NASDAQ:FRVO rose 3.8% in Wednesday's trading after saying it executed a new 105 MW transmission service agreement with Longroad Energy for development of the Cape Station geothermal project in Beaver County, Utah, where Fervo has been developing geothermal energy infrastructure.Fervo N…

children: rose 3.8% in Wednesday's trading after saying it executed a new 105 MW transmission service agreement with Longroad Energy for development of the Cape Station geothermal project in Beaver County, Utah, where Fervo has been developing geothermal energy infrastructure.

said the deal gives it long-term, firm delivery rights on the Milford Gen Lead line and builds on the parties' existing 400 MW arrangement, raising Cape Station's total contracted long-term firm transmission capacity to 505 MW.

"Longroad has worked alongside Fervo since its first efforts in Beaver County, and we're excited to collaborate again," Longroad Energy's chief development officer said. "Providing transmission service for this next phase helps deliver clean, around-the-clock power to the grid."
The transmission service agreement is expected to begin in 2028, subject to regulatory approvals.
